title: openHAB Item Update Weekly Update Latency Trend
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=openhab:event latency_ms=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(latency_ms) as avg_duration, max(latency_ms) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst update latency for openHAB item update events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture latency_ms on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average update latency with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It charts whether openHAB item update tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
